Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. Please have the employee try the following:
Make sure the employee is accessing the correct URL: There should be no additional text after what is listed here, as page-specific data can corrupt the login. If the employee is accessing the site via a bookmark or shortcut, that may need to be updated as well. Clear the browser cache at this workstation, in order to prevent any outdated data from corrupting the login. The following link will assist you with this process: Browser Maintenance Try logging in using a different browser.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
